card.name: Linking words before a contrasting or negative item
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, and, or, as, /) that come right after a positive item and just before a contrasting, negative or opposite item, such as 'do good and to avoid evil'.

modes.description: The word 'to' or 'and' sits between a good example and an instruction to avoid or learn from a bad one.

modes.description: A linking word joins a good thing to its counterpart or alternative.
